column1: List of conditions to add or expand on the topic of elastic collisions: 1. Collisions on irregular terrain 2. Changing the direction of gravity in a gravitational field 3. Collisions with objects made of different materials 4. Collisions on inclined planes 5. Collisions between stationary and moving obstacles 6. Collisions on surfaces with varying friction 7. Observing collisions in a transparent medium 8. Collisions by increasing the complexity of object shapes (e.g., polyhedra) 9. Collisions in a magnetic field 10. Collision experiments in water (or other liquids) 11. Changing the density of objects to observe collision effects 12. Collisions between elastic and inelastic walls 13. Collision experiments at different heights on the ground 14. Collisions on a rotating platform 15. Collision experiments on multi-level surfaces (e.g., steps)
